jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Agentic AI & Platform Monetization
jobs.description:
Position:
Senior Product Manager – Agentic AI & Platform Monetization

Job Description:
Are you looking to join a dynamic, DevOps-driven team within a large organization that still operates with a start-up mindset? Are you passionate about applied AI, agentic experiences, and building products that turn platform value into recurring revenue? This opportunity is for you.
Within the Cloud & AI division, you will join the Product team responsible for shaping ArrowSphere’s AI product family – the Assistant and the AI 360 Dashboard – driving the rise of AI Agents, and monetizing the platform’s value-added services across the distribution ecosystem.
Your Mission
As Senior Product Manager for AI Products & Monetization, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of ArrowSphere’s AI portfolio and its commercial model. You will define, prioritize, and execute a roadmap that scales adoption of our AI experiences (Assistant, AI 360 Dashboard, Agents) while designing the pricing, packaging, and value-added services that convert that adoption into sustainable, recurring revenue.
Key Responsibilities
AI Product Management
- Own the roadmap for ArrowSphere’s AI product family: the Assistant, the AI 360 Dashboard, and AI Agents
- Gather, prioritize, and translate user needs and market signals into product requirements and a well-groomed backlog
- Partner with engineering, DevOps, data, and UX teams to deliver high-value AI features
- Define and track KPIs (adoption, engagement, retention, agent task success) and continuously optimize
- Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of AI initiatives from discovery to launch

AI & Agentic Strategy
- Shape the vision for agentic experiences that automate and augment partner and end-customer workflows
- Evolve the Assistant and AI 360 Dashboard into daily-use, decision-driving tools
- Identify high-impact use cases where AI Agents match partners to the right offers and next-best actions
- Stay ahead of GenAI and agentic trends and translate them into a differentiated product strategy

Platform Monetization & Value-Added Services
- Design pricing, packaging, and bundling for AI features and the platform’s value-added services
- Build and grow recurring revenue streams tied to AI usage, agents, and premium capabilities
- Define the commercial model (consumption, subscription, tiering) together with finance and sales
- Analyze margin, conversion, and monetization KPIs to optimize the value-to-revenue equation
- Identify and prioritize new value-added services across the distribution value chain

Stakeholder Management
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams: sales, marketing, finance, operations, support
- Engage with cloud vendors and strategic partners on AI and monetization initiatives
- Ensure alignment across stakeholders on the AI roadmap and its commercial model
- Support RFPs and position ArrowSphere’s AI differentiation in strategic opportunities

Go-To-Market & Product Marketing
- Drive go-to-market strategies for new AI features, agents, and monetized services
- Develop and maintain product assets: value narratives, pricing collateral, demos, documentation
- Partner with marketing teams to drive demand generation (campaigns, events, content)
- Ensure proper communication of AI product releases internally and externally

Training & Enablement
- Enable internal teams (sales, support, business development) on the AI portfolio and its commercial model
- Help partners and customers extract value from the Assistant, AI 360 Dashboard, and Agents
- Create training materials and educational content
- Drive change management and foster adoption of new AI-powered tools and monetized services

Profile
- Minimum 10 years of experience as a Product Manager, including senior / lead scope
- Proven experience building and monetizing AI / GenAI or data products (pricing, packaging, recurring revenue)
- Strong experience in the cloud distribution ecosystem (vendor, distributor, or partner)
- Solid understanding of agentic AI, LLM-powered assistants, and analytics / dashboard products
- Track record of turning platform capabilities into measurable commercial value
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Comfortable working in an international environment

Languages
- Fluent English (mandatory)
- French (minimum B2 level)

Required Skills
- Product Management (roadmap, discovery, delivery)
- AI / GenAI and agentic product experience (functional depth expected)
- Monetization: pricing, packaging, value-added services, recurring-revenue models
- Cloud ecosystem and distribution models
- Tools: Jira, Confluence, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint
- UX / Design tools: Figma, Balsamiq, Adobe XD or equivalent

Recruitment Process
- HR Interview
- Interview with Global Product Management Director
- Interview with CTO Cloud & AI

Benefits
- Mostly remote position
- 50% public transportation reimbursement
- Health insurance included
- Works council benefits
- 10 additional RTT days per year

Arrow is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to create a diverse working environment by providing equal employment opportunity for all qualified persons.

Do you see yourself as our future colleague? If yes, please submit your application in English.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Position:
Product Marketing Manager

Job Description:
What You'll Be Doing
• The liaison/interface between Arrow's suppliers and Arrow sales team.
• The main purpose of the position is to develop, grow and leverage the influential supplier relationships to negotiate competitive pricing and availability, to increase sales and gross profit dollars for all regions.
• As the primary point of contact between the Arrow sales team and the supplier, Product Specialists also arrange meetings via webcast, phone, or in person in order to drive and increase our market share.
• Learns quickly the process of: returns, quotes, delivery, pricing and special restrictions.
• Identifies manufacturing problems to resolve delivery response issues and utilizes management's help when necessary. Investigates price anomalies across all regions and works to maintain price stability.
• Works with management to overcome obstacles within a supplier and makes it transparent to the sales team. Needs coaching to prioritize and adjust to changing markets, customer demands and supplier changes. Able to deliver corporate directives into job with management guidance.
• Engages in strategic conversations with sales leaders to strategize on opportunities while leveraging influential supplier relationships to develop sales strategies and goals for the product group. Offers competitive solutions. Follows up with sales daily quotes.
• Drives multi-location/global quotes and determines support for both franchised and non-franchised suppliers. Turn quotes quickly. Generates sales growth from quarter to quarter. Works backlog to manage on time delivery. Meets all business report card requirements.

What We Are Looking For
• Sales/PM professional with at least 3 years of experience in a semiconductor distributor.
• English communication skills (both spoken and written), with the ability to work directly with overseas suppliers.
• FPGA experience is highly preferred.

What's In It For You
At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans, and a solid benefits package.
• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
• Life Insurance
• Performance Bonus
• Paid Time Off
• Special/Extra Leave
• 5-Day Work Week
• Growth Opportunities
• And more!

About Arrow
Arrow Electronics, Inc. (NYSE: ARW), an award-winning Fortune 148 and one of Fortune Magazine’s Most Admired Companies. Arrow guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of USD $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. Our broad portfolio that spans the entire technology landscape helps customers create, make and manage forward-thinking products that make the benefits of technology accessible to as many people as possible. Learn more at www.arrow.com.

Our strategic direction of guiding innovation forward is expressed as Five Years Out, a way of thinking about the tangible future to bridge the gap between what's possible and the practical technologies to make it happen. Learn more at https://www.fiveyearsout.com/.

For more job opportunities, please visit https://careers.arrow.com/us/en.

Location:
TW-Taipei, Taiwan (Jian-Yi Rd)

Time Type:
Full time

Job Category:
Product & Supplier Management

jobs.title: Analytics Product Owner
jobs.description:
Position:
Analytics Product Owner

Job Description:
The Analytics Product Owner owns the vision, prioritization, and delivery of analytics products that enable data‑driven decision‑making across the business. This role operates at the intersection of business, data, and technology—translating complex business needs into clear, actionable analytics work.
You will own the analytics backlog end‑to‑end, facilitate agile execution, and ensure the analytics team is delivering high‑quality, trustworthy insights aligned with both strategic priorities and near‑term business needs.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating clarity, making trade‑offs, and helping analytics teams focus on outcomes—not just output.

Key Responsibilities
Product Ownership & Prioritization
- Own and maintain the analytics product backlog, translating business objectives into well‑defined user stories with clear acceptance criteria
- Prioritize work based on business value, effort, and risk—balancing strategic initiatives with urgent business needs
- Ensure all analytics work aligns with agreed‑upon outcomes and stakeholder expectations

Agile Delivery & Execution
- Lead agile ceremonies including daily stand‑ups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
- Actively manage work in JIRA: ticket creation, prioritization, dependency tracking, and status updates
- Monitor delivery timelines, manage trade‑offs, and proactively communicate risks and progress to stakeholders and leadership

Stakeholder Engagement
- Partner closely with stakeholders across product, engineering, marketing, finance, and operations to gather requirements and set realistic expectations
- Act as the primary point of contact for analytics requests, ensuring clarity before work enters the backlog
- Translate technical progress into clear, business‑friendly updates

Quality & Enablement
- Ensure analytics deliverables are accurate, documented, and usable by decision‑makers
- Remove blockers for the analytics team and facilitate smooth cross‑functional communication
- Drive continuous improvement in analytics workflows, documentation, and agile practices

Hands‑On Contribution
- Perform occasional light technical tasks such as simple dashboard updates using existing data models

Required Qualifications
- Proven experience as a Product Owner, Analytics Product Manager, or Project Manager in an analytics, data, or SaaS environment
- Strong experience running agile ceremonies and managing delivery for analytics or data teams
- Hands‑on experience managing complex backlogs and cross‑team dependencies in JIRA
- Ability to write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for analytics and data work
- Solid understanding of analytics concepts such as dashboards, reporting, metrics, and data pipelines
- Experience making prioritization decisions with incomplete or evolving information
- Excellent communication skills with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
- Basic experience modifying dashboards in Power BI or a comparable BI tool using pre‑built data models
- English proficiency: TOEFL (or equivalent) ≥ 90

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working closely with data analysts, data engineers, and data scientists
- SaaS or technology business analytics experience
- Familiarity with Databricks
- Familiarity with secure software development practices
- Experience using Git (any platform)
- Experience in scaled agile or multi‑team environments
- Background in product management or data‑driven organizations
- Prior experience working with a US‑based technology company or startup
- English proficiency: TOEFL (or equivalent) ≥ 90

jobs.title: Product Owner / Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Position:
Product Owner / Senior Product Owner

Job Description:
We are seeking a Product Owner/Senior Product Owner who bridges the gap between business needs and technical execution. This role involves gathering and analyzing requirements, translating them into actionable user stories, and managing the product backlog to ensure the successful delivery of software solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software engineering, business analysis, and Agile

Key Responsibilities:
- Collaborate with stakeholders (PMs, UX, Data, and Business teams) to gather and define business requirements.
- Translate business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable software requirements and user stories.
- Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring prioritization aligns with business goals and technical feasibility.
- Work closely with development teams to clarify requirements and ensure successful implementation.
- Facilitate Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and reviews.
- Continuously refine and evolve product requirements based on feedback and changing business needs.
- Ensure requirements are consistent, unambiguous, and well-documented.
- Act as the voice of the customer within the development team, ensuring solutions deliver value.
- Support testing and validation efforts to ensure delivered features meet requirements.

- Define functional requirements for AI-enabled features, including expected behavior, input/output scenarios, fallback handling, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Establish clear acceptance criteria and evaluation measures for AI outputs, covering accuracy, relevance, consistency, safety, and acceptable quality thresholds.
- Collaborate with AI, engineering, QA, and business teams to refine prompts, identify edge cases, validate AI behavior, and maintain up-to-date AI feature documentation

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in software requirements engineering, product ownership, or business analysis.
- Strong understanding of software development processes and system analysis.
- Proven experience working in Agile environments.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to break down complex business problems into structured technical solutions.
- Experience with Agile tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
- Solid understanding of UX principles and data-driven decision-making is a plus.
- Experience defining, validating, or managing requirements for AI-enabled or generative AI products, including prompts, response behavior, edge cases, and fallback scenarios.
- Good understanding of generative AI concepts and limitations, including non-deterministic outputs, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, guardrails, human review, and AI evaluation methods
